body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: The target rolls a Combat Card with a Success Die below 6, before spending Surges. Response (unopposed): Increase that Success Die by 1, to a maximum of 6; this changes no Surge generation.

surges.html: The target ignores one ordinary -1 Success Die penalty on that card.
After that card, the target may move 1 unit. This grants no additional Action.
